name: shared-check-service
goal: Two independent sessions share one low-priority candidate batch, run only impacted checks, and reuse exact-tree proof without rerunning checks.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Tracker tzd4cwp6ss plan records shared host queue, isolated current-main batch, dependency-selected normal checks, explicit release checks, exact-tree reuse and per-item evidence. Sibling items bxd6cn and x9b4rr received ownership notes.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented host queue and primary Mac test guard, candidate batch and failure split, existing graph selection, exact-tree local and shared result receipts, GitHub receipt admission, and Tracker notes.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Primary Mac focused integration suite passes. Independent processes submit overlapping commits, one tree selects 3 checks and excludes the unrelated test, warm rerun executes 0 checks, bisection isolates the failure, exact landing reuses the matching result, and a separate bare Git remote serializes two cache misses and publishes one source-free receipt.
